page.layout: One printed page on the right of the scan, blank apart from a water stain and show-through; the left edge shows the fore-edge of a neighbouring page with faint margin text that is cut off and not legible enough to transcribe.
page.notes: The right-hand page is blank: no text, page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed on it. The brownish stain at the top and the grey marks are damp and foxing, not print. The left strip shows the edge of the facing page; its faint marginal print is cut off and is not transcribed.
